answer: At dawn each epoch, paid work slots open and each agent must burn a deposit to claim one: crossing a canyon costs one toll each. The deposit is shale-thin at 40 POA and destroyed, never refunded, so 100 fake identities burn 4,000 POA while an honest agent pays 40 POA once. Slots are capped, so extra identities earn no extra income, and a rented slot pays the burner, not the renter. Honest agents pay once for a full epoch of paid work.
